5759.title: Unbounded terminal-history reads in host operations
5759.rootCauseOneLine: Host terminal listing and creation counting omit host predicates, causing full terminal-history scans before JavaScript filtering.
5759.proposedFix: Constrain both host-specific terminal lookups with the existing host scope; keep the remaining filters unchanged and guard against full-table scans through real route/database tests.
5759.caveats: Production freeze frequency and CLI wall-clock timing were not reproduced; the real server query-plan defect was repeated in a second clean trusted checkout. Reproduction patch is inline to comply with reports repository policy.
